evidence.source: Winbond W29N01HV datasheet Read ID, memory organization, and feature tables
evidence.notes: The datasheet confirms the five-byte Read ID, 1Gb SLC density, 2.7V to 3.6V supply, 2KB page, 128KB block, 64B spare, and lack of cache programming. The same ID covers x8 and x16 ordering variants, so width is intentionally not decoded.

evidence.source: Winbond W29N02GV datasheet Read ID, memory organization, and feature tables
evidence.notes: The datasheet confirms the five-byte Read ID, 2Gb SLC density, 2.7V to 3.6V supply, 2KB page, 128KB block, 64B spare, and cache programming support. The same ID covers x8 and x16 ordering variants, so width is intentionally not decoded.

evidence.source: Winbond W29N08GV datasheet Read ID, memory organization, and feature tables

evidence.source: Macronix MX30LF1G18AC datasheet ID Read, feature, and organization tables
evidence.notes: The official datasheet confirms the five-byte ID and the 1Gb x8 SLC, 2.7V to 3.6V, 2KB page, 128KB block, 64B spare, one-die, one-plane, cache-program, and 4-bit ECC per 528B profile.

evidence.source: Macronix MX30LF2G18AC and MX30LF4G18AC datasheet ID Read, feature, and organization tables
evidence.notes: The official datasheet confirms both IDs and their 2Gb/4Gb x8 SLC densities, 2.7V to 3.6V supply, 2KB page, 128KB block, 64B spare, one-die, two-plane, cache-program, and 4-bit ECC per 528B profiles.

evidence.source: Macronix MX60LF8G18AC datasheet ID Read, feature, and organization tables
evidence.notes: The official datasheet confirms the ID and 8Gb x8 SLC, two-die, four-plane, 2.7V to 3.6V, 2KB page, 128KB block, 64B spare, cache-program, interleave, and 4-bit ECC per 528B profile.

evidence.source: Macronix MX30LF1G28AD, MX30LF2G28AD, and MX30LF4G28AD datasheet ID Read, feature, and organization tables
evidence.notes: The official datasheet confirms all three six-byte IDs. The 1Gb/2Gb profiles use 2KB pages, 128KB blocks and 128B spare, while the 4Gb profile uses a 4KB page, 256KB block and 256B spare; all are x8 SLC with 8-bit ECC per 544B.

evidence.source: Macronix MX60LF8G18AC to MX60LF8G28AD migration application note device identification table
evidence.notes: The official migration note confirms the six-byte 8Gb 28AD ID and its 4KB page, 256KB block, 32B spare per 512B, 8-bit ECC, multi-die, interleave, and cache-program differences from 18AC.

evidence.source: Macronix MX30UF1G28AD, MX30UF2G28AD, and MX30UF4G28AD datasheet ID Read and organization tables
evidence.notes: The official datasheet confirms all three 1.8V x8 SLC IDs. The 1Gb/2Gb profiles use 2KB pages, 128KB blocks and 128B spare, while the 4Gb profile uses a 4KB page, 256KB block and 256B spare; all require 8-bit ECC per 544B.

evidence.source: Macronix MX60UF8G28AD datasheet ID Read and organization tables
evidence.notes: The official datasheet confirms the 8Gb 1.8V x8 SLC ID, two-die/four-plane organization, 4KB page, 256KB block, 256B spare, cache/interleave support and 8-bit ECC per 544B.

evidence.source: Macronix MX30UF1G16/18AC and MX30UF2G16/18AC datasheet ID Read and organization tables
evidence.notes: The official 1Gb and 2Gb family datasheets confirm the x8/x16 device IDs, 1.8V SLC organization, 2KB page, 128KB block, 64B spare, one/two-plane profiles, cache programming and 4-bit ECC per 512B.

evidence.source: Macronix MX30UF4G16/18AC and MX30UF4G16/18AB datasheet ID Read and organization tables
evidence.notes: The official AC and AB datasheets confirm the same x8/x16 IDs and the 4Gb 1.8V SLC, 2KB page, 128KB block, 64B spare, two-plane, cache-program and 4-bit ECC per 512B profiles.

evidence.source: Macronix MX60UF8G18AC datasheet ID Read and organization tables
evidence.notes: The official datasheet confirms the 8Gb 1.8V x8 SLC ID, two-die/four-plane organization, 2KB page, 128KB block, 64B spare, cache/interleave support and 4-bit ECC per 512B.

evidence.source: Macronix MX30UF4G28AC datasheet ID Read and organization tables
evidence.notes: The official datasheet confirms the 4Gb 1.8V x8 SLC ID, 2KB page, 128KB block, 128B spare, two-plane organization, cache programming and 8-bit ECC per 512B.

evidence.source: Macronix MX30LF1GE8AB, MX30LF2GE8AB, and MX30LF4GE8AB datasheet ID Read, organization, and internal ECC tables
evidence.notes: The official datasheet confirms all three 3V x8 SLC IDs, 2KB page, 128KB block, 64B spare, one/two-plane organization, cache programming and always-enabled internal 4-bit ECC.
